# Known false positives for the CodeQL report job in .github/workflows/codeql.yml.
#
# One entry per line: <rule id> <path>. A result is dropped from the count only when both its rule id and its file path match an entry. Paths carry no line number, because line numbers move. A blank line and a line starting with # are ignored.
#
# Every entry is rust/hard-coded-cryptographic-value. Each flagged value is a fixed public domain-separation label or a value that only a test uses. None is a password, a key, or an IV, so no secret is exposed and no cipher is weakened.
